name: NOAA Weather
author: Joshua Gauthreaux
description: Current conditions and a multi-day forecast from NOAA (weather.gov) for one or more US locations, entered as a ZIP, a city name, or lat,lon. No API key required.

barWidget.description: Weather for one or more locations from NOAA. US only; no API key. One widget holds every location, so only one instance is needed.

schema.label: Locations
schema.description: Semicolon-separated (a comma would split "Austin, TX" in half). Each entry is a US ZIP (78701), a city (Austin, TX), or lat,lon. Append |Name to rename one, e.g. 78701|Home. The first location is shown in the bar; the rest are reachable in the popup with the arrow keys.

schema.label: Units (f or c)
schema.description: f for Fahrenheit, c for Celsius.

schema.label: Show temperature next to the icon
Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: NOAA updates hourly; polling faster only risks rate limiting.

schema.label: User-Agent
schema.description: NOAA asks callers to identify themselves. Optional but polite: put a contact address here.

schema.label: Weather provider
schema.description: Filename in providers/. Empty uses the bundled NOAA provider. Any executable taking <lat> <lon> [alias] [fallback-label] and printing a page object works.
